Type: OpenClaw Skill

This skill bundle is classified as benign. It demonstrates a strong security-first design, implementing robust input sanitization for incident/service IDs (e.g., `^[A-Za-z0-9]+$` regex in `scripts/pager-triage.sh`), mandatory `--confirm` flags for all write operations (acknowledged in `SKILL.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `SPEC.md`), and secure handling of API keys (read from environment variables only, masked in error messages, never outputted). The `pd_api` function in `scripts/pager-triage.sh` strictly enforces HTTPS for all API calls, preventing arbitrary network requests. Comprehensive `SECURITY.md`, `OPERABILITY.md`, `SPEC.md`, and `TESTING.md` files further detail the security model, threat mitigations, and testing of these controls, indicating a highly security-conscious development process.
